post_measurement_change: Serial rollback retains original generation-before-classifier quota admission at the last RPM slot; added regression tests. No normal-load timing paths changed. Pending-output cap applies only until verdict, preserving approved long streams; regression tested. No observed sample hits this cap.
method: HTTP POST /api/v1/agent/chat to first real text.delta; fresh guest per request, no warmup/retries/exclusions; 20 paired rounds, pair order reversed each round
percentile_method: Existing measure.py estimator: sorted values[clamp(round(p/100*n+0.5)-1)]. For n=20 P95 is the maximum (conservative). P50 is statistics.median.

environment.database: isolated local pgvector/PostgreSQL 17; shared by two ports, fresh guests
environment.embedding: local bge-m3 configuration retained; SPRING_AI_MODEL_EMBEDDING=none for isolated evaluation; no external embedding calls

limitations: One machine/time window; four samples per category; no concurrent traffic or warmup
Actual job-search request may use local snapshot fallback; no selected resources or authenticated career/coach evidence
No production SLO claim. History/images/selected resources/HITL/quota/cancel tested offline
Expert optimization overlaps RESUME/JOB action parsing only; final narration still waits for necessary tool/note results
No fixed SC-01 injection error exists in blocking implementation; parallel hit discards candidate and reruns exact category-warning prompt
